REVENUE MEMORANDUM CIRCULAR NO. 3-2024 issued on January 10, 2024 circularizes
Republic Act (RA) No. 11976 (Ease of Paying Taxes [EOPT] Act), together with the Veto Message
both signed by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on January 5, 2024.
         The following Sections of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC) were amended
under the EOPT Act:
         a.   Section 21. Sources of Revenue and Classification of Taxpayers
         b.   Section 22. Definitions
         c.   Section 51. Individual Returns
         d.   Section 56. Payment and Assessment of Income Tax for Individuals and
              Corporations
         e.   Section 57. Withholding of Tax at Source
         f.   Section 58. Returns and Payment of Taxes Withheld at Source
         g.   Section 76. Final Adjustment Return
         h.   Section 77. Place and Time of Filing and Payment of Quarterly Corporate Income
              Tax
         i.   Section 81. Filing of Return and Payment of Taxes Withheld
         j.   Section 90. Estate Tax Returns
         k.   Section 91. Payment of Tax
         l.   Section 103. Filing of Return and Payment of Tax
         m. Section 106. Value-Added Tax on Sale of Goods or
